description: Official IESO excerpts in native format for the Ontario Price archive tests (scripts/archive_ontario_price.py): the Day-Ahead Hourly Ontario Zonal Price report listing (rows for the dateless latest file, 2026-09-15, 2026-09-24 unversioned/v1/v2/v3 and 2026-10-08) and four complete daily reports (2026-09-15 v1; 2026-09-24 v1 and v3, identical prices with different CreatedAt times; 2026-10-08 v1); the hourly LFDA listing and CSV rows (2025-05-01 published blank, 2025-05-03, and 2026-09-15 and 2026-09-24 as retrieved on 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-15: 2026-09-15 went from Preliminary to Final, four hours changing value); the Ontario Market Prices monthly tables (tabs AA and WA, four months); and the IESO website chart API response for 2026-10-08 (not a published report).
